article:
For each question, write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.

[--- Table Start ---]
| Review of Amazing A new play called Amazing is now on at the Town Theatre, and it's really worth seeing. The action takes place in a school, and the play starts by showing a group of students inventing an extraordinary machine. They then use this machine in order (27)…………… learn about history and other school subjects by travelling backwards through time. (28)…………… example, we see exactly what had happened when important medicines (29)…………… discovered.  (30)…………… the story is extremely interesting, some of the acting is not so good. None (31)…………… the actors are very well known, and I think the play would be a bit better if it had more experienced people in the main roles.  Despite (32)……………, I would definitely recommend you to go and see it because of the fantastic story, and the rather surprising ending. |
[--- Table End ---]

explanations.27:
原因：“in order to learn” 表目的，“为了学习历史”，to 后接动词原形。
语法点：in order to do/to do 表目的，如 “He gets up early to catch the bus.”
explanations.28:
原因：“for example” 固定短语，表 “例如”，举例说明时间旅行的用途。
词汇点：for example=for instance，后接句子，如 “Some cities, for example, Beijing, are very crowded.”
explanations.29:
原因：一般过去时被动语态，“medicines were discovered”，药物被发现。
语法点：复数主语 medicines+were done，如 “The books were written by him.”
explanations.30:
原因：让步状语从句引导词，“尽管故事有趣，演技不佳”。
语法点：although/though 表 “虽然”，不可与 but 连用，如 “Although he is old, he is healthy.”
explanations.31:
原因：“none of the actors” 表 “没有一个演员”，none of + 复数名词。
词汇点：none of + 可数 / 不可数名词，如 None of the students passed the exam.
explanations.32:
原因：指代前文 “演技不佳”，“尽管如此，仍推荐”。
词汇点：that 指代上文提到的情况，如 “I was late. That made my teacher angry.”
